_about: Bios sent after the bios doc was finished. Each entry replaces that person's After text from bios-source.txt, word for word, so a fresh download of the doc doesn't undo it. The descriptor also goes on their Our Team card.

courtney eason.from: Courtney's email to Becky, forwarded Oct 29 2026
courtney eason.descriptor: Master of Calendars | Dessert Enthusiast | Witty Dance Mom | Suburban Adventurer
bio: I’ve called Durham home since 2011, and I’m still happy to brag about it. Before real estate, I spent more than 20 years in customer-focused careers, building relationships with clients, patients, and their families. That work gave me a sharp eye for detail, a listening ear, and a strong instinct to advocate for the people I’m working with.

Parenting took care of the rest. I’m organized, efficient, and have learned not to take myself too seriously. With a wife, two kids, and two cats at home, I know a house has to do more than look good. It has to feel like home, and I believe home is where people and families get to feel safe being exactly who they are. Whether you’re buying or selling, I’ll keep the details handled, the calendar under control, and the process as painless as I can make it.

candace jones.from: Candace's email to Josh, Oct 30 2026 (new descriptor only; bio is the doc's After text, unchanged)
candace jones.descriptor: Always Curious | Artist | Uncompetitive Runner | In My Brady Bunch Era
bio: At 5'1", I'm ideal for inspecting crawl spaces, but I might need your help reaching the attic. In 2017, my family and I relocated from Pennsylvania to Durham, looking for a diverse town to raise our three kids, including my daughter, adopted from Ethiopia. After multiple moves, a divorce, and a career change, I'm now in my Brady Bunch era with a blended family of seven. Embracing life's surprises has prepared me to support you through your own transition.

shan deberry.from: Shan's Oct 29 2026 bio, forwarded by Tammi Nov 4 2026; trimmed for the site (descriptor word for word)
shan deberry.descriptor: Rottie Mama | Water Baby | Coffee Shop Connoisseur | Serious Foodie | Event Curator | Curl Whisperer | Creative Soul | Connection Queen
bio: I’ve always been drawn to people, possibilities, and a good transformation, so I love helping you find your place and see the potential in a home. Serving Durham and the surrounding Triangle, I keep buying and selling personal. I listen, give honest guidance, and negotiate in your best interest, because protecting your interests will always matter more to me than making a sale.

Over 30 years as an entrepreneur, educator, and creative professional gave me a knack for organizing projects and finding solutions. Whether you’re getting a home ready to sell or exploring one to buy, I’ll help you see the bigger picture, line up qualified pros, and build a practical plan. Off the clock, I’m discovering a new coffee shop, enjoying live music, or escaping near the water. I love time with my family and my Rottweilers, Roxy and Debo, and after decades in the beauty industry, I still love playing in curls!

connie semans.from: Connie's email to Josh, Nov 5 2026 (current bio; descriptor unchanged from the doc)
connie semans.descriptor: Creator | Forest Bather | Forager and Chef
bio: Real estate should be an exciting milestone, not a source of chaos. Drawing on a diverse professional background—from archivist and tech consultant to project manager and stager—I bring a detail-oriented, low-drama approach to every transaction. Whether staging a home to maximize your return or matching a buyer with a space that truly fits their daily life, I focus on client-centric service and clear, calm guidance.

I know buying or selling a home is often your biggest financial investment, and I don’t take that fiduciary responsibility lightly. From managing contractors and anticipating inspection details to building a genuine connection that lasts long after closing day, I handle the heavy lifting so you can move forward with confidence.
